parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of a toilet, typically made of durable plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to activate the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position after releasing.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of ceramic material, forming the bowl and base structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user’s weight, collects waste, and channels it into the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary during use.
